# `employment_version`

Effective-dated employment attributes with recorded time (EMP-08).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | people |
| Kind | version |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `effective_from`, `effective_to`, `recorded_at` |
| Retention class | `employment-record`: Personnel history retained after employment ends per the legal pack and tenant policy (NFR-05, DOC-17). Period: comes from an approved pack, none exists yet. |
| API mapping | /v1/employments/{id}/versions (planned) |
| Write path | people repository createEmployment. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0003_people (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- FK (tenant_id, employment_id) -> employment
- effective_to >= effective_from
- no overlapping intervals per employment
- only an open version may be closed
- audit required (resource = employment_id)
